Finding new routes beyond roads. That’s us.

Mercedes-Benz is on an exciting journey of transformation. Our purpose is defined as “First Move the World.” We aim to be at the forefront of innovation, not only in automotive technology and luxury, but also in shaping a more sustainable and connected future. By combining pioneering products and services with a strong customer focus, we continue to set new standards in safety, digitalization and design.

Mercedes-Benz Danmark A/S is the general distributor for passenger cars, vans and aftersales products in Denmark. Working as part of the Sweden and Denmark cluster, we support our authorized retailers and workshops with sales, marketing and business development.

To strengthen our Danish used-car business, we are now looking for an analytical and commercially minded Used Car Specialist. The position is based at our office at Digevej, Copenhagen. You will be a part of a team across border and expect to travel to our Swedish office, based in Hyllie Malmö, on a regular basis.

**About The Position

**As Used Car Specialist, you will play an important role in driving our used car and remarketing activities in Denmark together with the team. You will combine commercial insight, data analysis and operational coordination to help ensure competitive pricing and efficient vehicle sales. Working closely with dealers, auction and remarketing partners, as well as Sales and other internal stakeholders, you will turn market data into clear recommendations and help create a professional, efficient vehicle journey from return to sale.

**Your main responsibilities within the team will include:

**

• Drive remarketing performance by analyzing sales, stock, pricing and market data and translating insights into commercial action.

• Own the remarketing journey from returned to sale.

• Enable high-quality vehicle sales by securing accurate documentation, equipment descriptions and vehicle data.

• Build strong partnerships with Danish dealers, auction platforms, logistics providers and other remarketing partners.

• Support the team in improving processes, reporting and data quality across the remarketing journey.

**Who Are You

**You are analytical, structured and curious about understanding what drives business performance. You enjoy working with data and figures, but also appreciate collaborating with colleagues, dealers and external partners.

You are proactive, detail-oriented and motivated to learn new skills in a dynamic commercial environment.

**We believe you bring:

**We believe you are at the beginning of your career with approximately 1-3 years of experience from a similar position. Your educational background could be within business, finance, economics, sales, automotive management or a related field, but we will also look at candidates with a different educational background with curiosity so don’t hesitate to apply.

• Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate data and market developments into action.

• Solid Excel skills and the ability to work with large datasets.

• Commercial understanding, combined with a structured and quality-conscious approach.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills and ability to build trustful relationships with our dealers and partners.

• Professional proficiency in Danish and English, both written and spoken.

Experience from the automotive or used car industry, vehicle appraisal, trade-in activities or auction and remarketing platforms will be considered an advantage.

**What We Offer

**This is an opportunity to take on a varied and commercially important role at the center of the Danish used-car business. You will have the chance to influence remarketing performance, pricing decisions and residual-value development while working closely with dealers, partners and colleagues across the Mercedes-Benz organization.

You will join an international and collaborative environment where data, customer focus and continuous improvement are central to how we work. The role offers broad stakeholder exposure and a genuine opportunity to strengthen how we manage and develop the vehicle lifecycle in Denmark.

**Application

**For position specific information please contact Thomas Larsson thomas.larsson@mercedes-benz.com . For general information about the recruitment process, please contact Evelina Hofstedt, HR Partner at evelina.hofstedt@mercedes-benz.com .

We are keen to get the right candidate onboard as soon as possible; therefore, we practice continuous selection. So don't wait with your application, send it as soon as possible, however no later than 25th November. Please apply using the link below; we do not consider applications received via email.

We are one of the world’s most successful automotive companies. With its divisions Mercedes-Benz Cars, Mercedes-Benz Vans and Mercedes-Benz Financial Services, the Mercedes-Benz Group is one of the biggest producers of premium cars and the world’s biggest manufacturer of commercial vehicles with a global reach. Mercedes-Benz Financial Services provides financing, leasing, fleet management, insurance and innovative mobility services.

jobs.description:
**Help shape the future of supply chain planning

**We’re looking to expand our Copenhagen team with a **Senior Consultant / Solution Architect

**with a management consulting background and the expertise to design and implement SAP IBP solutions.

**What you’ll do

**As a senior member of our team, you’ll be working in the sweet spot **where consulting meets deep solution expertise.

**Specifically, you will:

• 
**Design end-to-end supply chain planning processes

**and facilitate key decisions with senior stakeholders

• 
**Step into the subject-matter expertise role,

**knowing how SAP IBP can improve demand, response & supply, inventory and/or S&OP

• 
**Bridge the gap between business and IT

**by translating client needs into robust, value-adding solutions while being able to challenge the client on the status quo

• 
**Drive project delivery from blueprint to go-live

**, ensuring meaningful client impact

• 
**Support business development

**through your consulting experience and client network in the Nordics

In addition to facilitating change management initiatives, you’ll be working with a team of younger consultants, providing guidance and support to ensure high-quality project delivery.

**What you’ll bring

**We’re looking for a seasoned consultant who combines structured thinking, technical depth, and a collaborative mindset. In the best-case scenario, you bring:

• **At least 4 years

**of **client-facing

**experience at a **management consulting firm

**, demonstrating strong team collaboration and interpersonal skills.

• Proven expertise **designing and delivering

**in one or more **SAP IBP solutions

**(demand, response & supply, inventory, S&OP)

• Strong capabilities and interpersonal skills to **facilitate workshops

**, align stakeholders, and articulate complex solutions through **clear PowerPoint storytelling

**

• Deep understanding of **supply chain planning processes and operating models

**

• A relevant master's degree (e.g., in Supply Chain, Engineering, or Business)

• Fluency in English; other languages are a plus

• A collaborative, entrepreneurial spirit – and a desire to reshape how consulting is done in the Nordics

**What we offer

**Our Planning Excellence team across EMEA has seen substantial growth over the past few years, thanks to our strong subject-matter expertise and our ability to drive effective change management in organisations seeking to transform their planning operating model.

Joining us means entering a world of:

• A unique culture of **freedom, trust, and responsibility

**

• Opportunities to work on **transformational projects

**with leading organisations

• A **flat organisation

**where your ideas and initiatives matter from day one

• A strong, performance-based compensation model

• A **growing, entrepreneurial international team

**backed by a strong Scandinavian brand

**About Implement Consulting Group

**Implement Consulting Group (founded 1996) is an international management consultancy with over 1,800 employees, making it one of the largest European consultancies. Headquartered in Copenhagen, the company has 12 offices across the Nordics, the DACH region, and the United States. Implement supports organisations in delivering sustainable strategic, commercial, and operational transformations. The company combines analytical rigour, functional expertise, and industry insight with a unique collaborative model and an ability to engage and mobilise client organisations.

**Ready to drive change with SAP IBP and shape the future of supply chain planning?

**Make your next move matter.

Apply now.

Do you enjoy outbound sales, building relationships, and creating new business opportunities? Are you a native or near-native German speaker with experience in B2B sales? Then you might be the next addition to our Outreach Team at PriceShape.

At PriceShape, you'll join an international SaaS company on a strong growth journey, where you'll play an important role in expanding our presence across German-speaking markets.

Your Role at PriceShape

As a Business Development Representative (BDR), your main responsibility will be to identify and engage potential customers through outbound outreach, generate interest in PriceShape, and book qualified meetings for our Business Development Managers (BDMs).

You'll work closely with fellow BDRs and BDMs, contributing to our sales efforts across the DACH region. While German will be your primary language when engaging with prospects, strong business-level English is essential for internal collaboration and communication with international prospects and customers.

What You'll Be Doing

• Identify and engage potential customers through outbound calls, emails, and LinkedIn.

• Build relationships with relevant decision-makers and understand their business needs.

• Communicate PriceShape's value proposition and generate interest in our solutions.

• Book qualified meetings and collaborate closely with BDMs to create new sales opportunities.

• Share market insights and contribute to improving our outreach efforts.

What We're Looking For

• Native or near-native German language skills.

• Strong business-level English, both written and spoken.

• Experience in outbound B2B sales, lead generation, or business development.

• A proactive and goal-oriented mindset with a strong commercial drive.

• Confident communication and relationship-building skills.

• The ability to thrive in a collaborative and international environment.

Depending on your experience and proven results, the scope of the role and compensation will be tailored accordingly.

What We Offer

• A fast-growing SaaS company with opportunities for personal and professional development.

• A collaborative and international sales team with a strong team spirit.

• Competitive salary with uncapped commission.

• Flexible working hours and a strong focus on work-life balance.

• A modern, centrally located office in Aarhus C with great facilities, an in-house canteen, and social activities.

• Pension and health insurance.

**About PriceShape

**PriceShape is a global leader in competitor monitoring and dynamic pricing. Our platform helps brands and online retailers track vendors' prices, stock availability, and trends while implementing tailored pricing strategies.

We’re a diverse team of 80 employees from 24 nationalities, working from a modern, centrally located office in Aarhus C. We prioritize work-life balance, trust, community and focus on personal and professional growth opportunities.

We believe in trust, flexibility, and continuous development, creating an environment where people can grow both personally and professionally.

How to Apply

If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, please send us your CV and application as soon as possible. We review applications on an ongoing basis.

For any questions about the role, feel free to reach out to People & Culture Business Partner Mathias Høgh Sønnichsen at mhs@priceshape.dk.

Are you the person who keeps a team moving and turns customer needs into clear decisions? At Playable, we help some of the world’s biggest brands bring playable marketing into their strategy, adding interactive experiences that audiences actually want to engage with. We’re looking for a Product Manager to work side by side with our VP of Product and be the link between the people who ask for things and the engineers who build them.

The role

You drive the day-to-day work around the roadmap: planning, priorities and follow-up. You make sure things get done. Planning is at the heart of it: the quarterly roadmap, what goes into each sprint, and what can wait. You keep us delivering on it while handling customer requests and ad-hoc needs without losing the thread. You work hands-on with the VP of Product to shape that roadmap, with room to take on more of it over time.

Our customers are marketers at enterprise brands, and they push the platform in new directions all the time. Your job is to make sure the best of those ideas make it into the product, and that the rest get a clear and honest “not now”.

The role includes

• Planning the quarterly roadmap with the VP of Product, and deciding what goes into each sprint

• Running day-to-day product operations: Jira, backlog, priorities and status

• Being the contact for customer feedback and roadmap questions between Customer Success, Sales and the development team, gathering requirements and keeping everyone updated

• Sparring with developers on scope and “how should this work?”, so the team gets clear answers and knows what matters most, and why

• Collecting and sorting customer requests and feedback, and speaking for the end user, both the marketers who build campaigns and the people who play them

• Following projects from idea to release, including reviews and up-to-date documentation

• Communicating progress and what’s coming, including the roadmap, to the team and the wider organisation

The ideal profile

• You’re structured, reliable and good with details, and you finish what you start. You like a fast pace and don’t need everything to be perfectly defined before you get going.

• Experience with product or project management in a software or SaaS team

• Comfortable working closely with developers

• You bring structure that helps the team move faster, not slower

• Customer-focused: you can turn what customers say into clear requirements and decisions the team can build from

• You can prioritise, say no, and explain why

• Clear communicator in English (Danish is a plus)

• A plus: experience with B2B SaaS, martech or enterprise customers

Let's put play to work

At Playable, we use the power of play to connect leading brands with consumers around the world – and change the game for ambitious marketers everywhere. Our flexible SaaS platform allows our customers to integrate playable marketing in all stages driving engagement.

While we have grown quickly, our success is fuelled by a work culture centred around what matters most to us: All the great people who make up our culture – and who make it all possible. You will be joining 70+ colleagues across different teams and roles. In fact, the Playable culture is our most powerful business driver. It guides and unites us across time zones - powering more metrics than any slide deck ever will. Here, you’re met by managers who trust that you’re the best for the job and who genuinely care for you. Not just your performance but your well-being. Both in and outside work.

Together, we’re here to do great work – and to have fun doing it. Because, every second of every day, people around the globe play our games, and we believe this is just the beginning. So, come join us and let’s put play to work.

Interested?

We will screen and interview candidates on an ongoing basis – so please, do not hesitate to apply. For further information and questions about the position, please contact VP Product, Nikolaj Stockholm, at nst@playable.com.

Your mission

As our Carbon Removal Supply Lead, a new role here at Klimate, you will build and own the systems, data, and market intelligence of our carbon supply sourcing. You will strengthen sourcing as a function and enable strategic and commercial decision-making grounded in strong supplier relationships, accurate market information, and well-governed internal data.

You will sit within the Sourcing team and report directly to Matt Averna, Head of Markets & Policy.

About Klimate

At Klimate, we enable companies pursuing real climate action to take responsibility for the emissions they can’t avoid. The world talks a lot about net-zero, but most companies struggle to know what to do once reductions are no longer enough. That’s where we come in. We are a science-led business with real experts guiding companies through the world of carbon removal and how they can safely invest in taking CO₂ out of the atmosphere. Our solution combines expertise, guidance and software to help companies understand what’s real, what works, what it costs, and how to do it credibly.

Founded in 2020, we are a tight-knit team of around 20 people from a great variety of nationalities united by a passion for scaling solutions to the climate crisis. We move quickly when it matters and focus on sharing ownership along the way. Besides working in teams we enable that ownership in squads making it possible for all employees to lead areas, they are passionate about. We value deep collaboration and working side-by-side in our central Copenhagen office, from where we support leading clients including Storebrand, Dalberg, OC&C, and many others.

You can get to know us a bit better on our website or on LinkedIn.

What you'll do

In the first 3–6 months, you will:

• Become fluent in Klimate’s sourcing priorities, supplier base, and contracting approach for carbon removal projects.

• Independently prepare for and contribute to supplier meetings, using structured data and clear market context.

• Support and share responsibility of supplier meetings, preparing materials and ensuring learnings are captured in internal systems.

• Manage projects and contracts in Klimate’s administrative inventory system, coordinating with internal stakeholders where needed.

• Take ownership of existing supplier and project data across sourcing systems, ensuring it is well structured, consistent, and up-to-date.

As you grow into the role, you will:

• Own the ongoing development and governance of Klimate’s sourcing database, ensuring it reliably supports day-to-day sourcing and strategic decision-making.

• Generate regular, data-driven market and commercial insights (e.g. pricing, geographies, project categories, contracting terms) to inform sourcing focus and prioritisation.

• Actively manage supplier relationships in collaboration with sourcing leadership, ensuring accurate management in our data systems.

• Execute contracting of carbon removal purchase agreements with structured inputs from market data and supplier interactions.

• Serve as a sparring partner to sourcing leadership and relevant internal teams on sourcing focus, market coverage, and portfolio construction.

**Requirements & Skills

**

Must-have

• Relevant work experience in carbon markets, climate tech, energy markets, or a closely related sourcing or market analysis field.

• Pre-existing experience working with carbon market supply, ideally in an intermediary or transaction-oriented role with broad market exposure.

• Strong understanding of commercial terms and contracting logic, and comfort engaging with complex contract language and deal structures.

• High data literacy, with experience designing, maintaining, and working with structured databases or admin systems (tool-agnostic).

• Comfort working at the intersection of supplier engagement, market analysis, and data operations, combining people-centric soft skills with quantitative ability.

• Ability to take ownership of complex, evolving problem spaces, translating high-level objectives into pragmatic execution.

Nice-to-have

• Direct experience with carbon removal projects or technologies.

• Experience producing external-facing market reports, briefs, or thought leadership content.

• Familiarity with policy or subsidy mechanisms relevant to carbon markets.

• Experience collaborating with product, sales, or digital teams on data or systems integration.

Who you are

• You are highly analytical and value data as the basis for decision-making.

• You are comfortable working independently within a coaching-oriented management style, translating broad direction into concrete actions.

• You proactively identify opportunities for improvement and propose ideas, analyses, or new ways of structuring work.

• You are curious, and motivated by bringing clarity and order to complex or fragmented information.

• You are comfortable representing Klimate externally in supplier conversations while grounding discussions in facts, data, and commercial logic.

What we offer

Beyond our mission and team culture, we aim to provide a workplace where you can grow professionally and contribute meaningfully to an industry that is rapidly evolving. We offer a competitive compensation package, opportunities to develop your skills, and an environment built on ownership, collaboration and trust.

Benefits

• Vacation: 30 days of paid holiday (5 weeks + 1 week of “feriefridage”).

• Pension & health insurance: Employer-supported pension scheme including health insurance.

• Learning & development: Annual learning budget to support your professional growth.

• Warrants: Eligibility for our warrant program depending on role and seniority.

• Flexibility: We have a weekly work from home day, and offer flexibility in working times and locations as needed.

• Central office location with lunch and great coffee: Cozy office located right next to Nørreport with a catered vegetarian lunch every day and excellent coffee provided by our clients Original Coffee and Prolog.

• Social activities: Team sessions every Friday and a variety of social activities, from foraging and cooking in Amager to trying our hand at pottery.

Start & Logistics

We will review applications on an ongoing basis and hire when we find the right candidate.

Start date: ASAP, ideally no later than April 2027.

Location: We expect this role to be Copenhagen based, but encourage anyone with permission to work in the EU to apply.

What to include in your application

• Your CV. Please leave out photos and identifying characteristics such as age, gender, nationality, etc.

• A short cover letter. Focus on your experience with carbon markets and working with data-driven decision making - those are the key elements of succeeding in the role.

Our hiring process

• 30 min intro interview with Britt, our People & Culture Partner

• 30 min interview with Matt, our head of Markets & Policy

• Small case & cultural interview with Matt and another member of the Klimate team

• Reference check

• Final conversation with our CEO, Mads Emil

• Offer

Equal Opportunities

Klimate is committed to equal opportunities for all people and ideas.

Even if you think you don’t meet all the requirements, we encourage you to apply.

We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply and strive to ensure an objective selection process.

Please leave out your date of birth, gender, marital status, nationality, photo, and other personal characteristics from your CV and application.

Director, Platform Engineering – Accelerate the SaaS transformation behind one of the world’s leading media platforms

Do you thrive at the intersection of organizational leadership, platform engineering, and SaaS transformation? Are you motivated by building teams and shared capabilities that enable other engineers to move faster, operate with greater autonomy, and deliver at scale?

At Stibo DX, we are looking for an experienced Director of Platform Engineering to lead a strategically important engineering domain and drive our transition toward SaaS.

The role

As Director of Platform Engineering, you will lead three global teams responsible for Cloud Platform, Print Platform, and Content Delivery. Together, these teams provide shared platform foundations, deployment capabilities, gateway infrastructure, APIs, and supporting services used across the Cue media enterprise platform.

Your primary mission is to accelerate the SaaS transformation. You will develop the domain into a coherent platform-engineering organization that provides standardized, reusable, and self-service capabilities, enabling application teams to deploy and operate their services without the Platform Engineering organization becoming a central delivery bottleneck.

A central part of the role is to establish clear organizational boundaries between Platform Engineering, application teams, SRE, and Operations. You will help shape a model in which Platform Engineering provides the shared foundation and developer enablement, while application teams remain accountable for the behavior, reliability, and operational outcomes of the services they build.

You will also lead the organization through this transition. Stibo DX is building toward a SaaS-first future while continuing to support self-hosted and hybrid customers. The role therefore requires someone who can balance the target state with pragmatic migration paths, preserving customer value while steadily reducing complexity and fragmentation.

Reporting directly to the CTO and serving both as a member of the Development Leadership Team and the company-wide Senior Leadership Team, you will lead a domain of 14 people and contribute to the continued development of both your domain and the wider engineering organization. The role can be based at any of our Stibo DX offices in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Hamburg, Oslo, or Málaga.

Key responsibilities

You will lead and develop a distributed engineering organization while creating the structure, capabilities, and momentum required to scale Stibo DX’s SaaS transformation. The role combines organizational leadership, platform strategy, developer enablement, and operational discipline, and requires close collaboration with Product Management, Architecture, SRE, Operations, and other engineering leaders.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Lead and develop the distributed Cloud Platform, Print Platform, and Content Delivery teams.

• Build a coherent platform-engineering organization with a shared mission, clear ownership, and strong execution.

• Accelerate the SaaS transformation by translating strategic direction into platform capabilities, adoption paths, and measurable outcomes.

• Provide standardized, reusable, and self-service capabilities that enable application teams to deploy and operate services independently.

• Treat the platform as a product, with clear internal users, priorities, adoption measures, and feedback loops.

• Establish clear boundaries between Platform Engineering, application teams, SRE, Operations, and Architecture.

• Drive platform adoption with the other Development leaders while keeping application migration and operational ownership within the application domains.

• Balance development of the target SaaS platform with pragmatic transition paths for self-hosted and hybrid customers.

• Build a culture of trust, accountability, constructive challenge, continuous improvement, and company-first leadership.

The ideal candidate

You are first and foremost an experienced engineering leader. You know how to create clarity, build effective teams, and translate strategic direction into coordinated execution across a complex engineering domain. You have successfully led distributed engineering teams in an international environment and bring experience from a customer-facing SaaS company or an organization transitioning toward SaaS delivery models.

You understand that developer enablement is how platform engineering scales. You know where a central platform team should build reusable capabilities, where it should provide standards and guardrails, and where application teams must retain ownership. You measure success through adoption and autonomy, not through the amount of work centralized in the platform organization.

You bring sufficient technical depth in platform engineering and SaaS to engage credibly with senior engineers and architects, understand trade-offs, ask incisive questions, guide the overall direction, and recognize whether teams are progressing toward a coherent and scalable platform. You are not expected to be hands-on or to act as the chief platform architect. Your role is to create the conditions for strong technical decisions and hold the organization accountable for sustained progress.

You are a strong people leader known for building trust, developing talent, and creating an environment where accountability, ownership, and continuous learning thrive. You communicate clearly, collaborate naturally across organizational boundaries, and contribute to the success of the wider company rather than focusing only on your own area.

Relevant experience

• Proven leadership experience from platform engineering, cloud-native engineering, developer platforms, or a closely related area.

• Experience leading multiple distributed engineering teams through organizational and technological change.

• Experience with customer-facing SaaS products and the organizational changes required to support SaaS-first delivery models.

• Broad understanding of platform engineering, internal developer platforms, self-service, AWS, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, APIs and gateways, observability, security, reliability, and cloud economics.

• Experience modernizing an established software platform while continuing to support legacy, self-hosted, or hybrid customer environments.

• A demonstrated ability to strengthen adoption of shared platforms and improve autonomy for application teams.

• Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to align across engineering, product, architecture, and operations.

• Fluency in English, spoken and written.

Interested?

Please apply through LinkedIn. We review applications as they are received and encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to an interview. The position will remain open until we have found the right candidate.

If you have questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Chief Technology Officer Jesper Broni Andersen by email at jba@stibodx.com. We look forward to hearing from you.

Help us empower storytellers across the globe

Stibo DX is the global leader in digital transformation for media enterprises. Our platform and services help automate complex content production and enable omnichannel delivery for some of the world's most ambitious and successful media organizations.

We are a global and dynamic team of over 200 employees based in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Atlanta, Hamburg, Oslo, and Málaga, combining creativity and innovation with the stability of a long-standing organization.

Stibo DX is part of the Stibo Software Group, the second-largest Danish-owned software group. Our roots trace back to the Stibo Foundation, which has a 228-year history and a rich legacy that supports our continued growth.

Read the Stibo DX story and about working at Stibo DX.

**Project Manager - IT, Automation & Robotics

**Location: Kalundborg, Denmark

****Department: API Expansions - Pre-G3 Projects & Project Execution

**Are you passionate about delivering complex projects and bringing innovative technologies into pharmaceutical manufacturing?

Do you enjoy collaborating across technical disciplines, turning challenges into opportunities and helping shape the future of production facilities?

We are looking for a Project Manager to join our IT, Automation & Robotics team within API Expansions at Novo.

This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to significant capital investment projects, working with experienced specialists and engineering partners to support the development and modernisation of our manufacturing facilities.

If you have project management experience, a good understanding of industrial IT and automation, and the ambition to develop your career within a growing project organisation, we would love to hear from you.

**The position

**As our new Project Manager, you will be responsible for leading IT, Automation and Robotics workstreams within largescale capital investment projects across API Expansions.

You will primarily work in the early phases of projects, helping define scope, establish requirements, develop reliable plans and forecasts, and ensure that technical uncertainties are identified and addressed before projects progress into execution.

Working closely with Solution Architects, engineering partners and colleagues across the organisation, you will help translate operational and technical requirements into structured project deliverables.

**Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Leading and coordinating IT, Automation and Robotics project activities within major capital investment programmes.

• Developing project scope, schedules, cost estimates, forecasts and delivery plans in accordance with Novo's global standards.

• Collaborating with Solution Architects and technical specialists to understand proposed solutions, dependencies and potential project risks.

• Working closely with Process, Engineering, Global IT, Quality and other stakeholders to align requirements and project objectives.

• Coordinating external engineering partners, suppliers and system integrators to support successful project delivery.

• Identifying technical uncertainties and opportunities early, helping establish robust solutions before projects move into detailed design and execution.

• Monitoring project progress, budgets, risks and deliverables, ensuring appropriate governance and reporting.

• Supporting the development and continuous improvement of project management processes, standards and ways of working within the department.

• You will typically be assigned to one major project, although you may occasionally support more than one project depending on their scope and complexity.

The position offers exposure to a diverse portfolio of projects, including purification, fermentation, recovery, logistics and utility facilities, providing opportunities to develop your experience across different manufacturing processes and technologies.

**Qualifications

**To succeed in this role, we imagine that you bring a combination of project management experience, technical understanding and strong interpersonal skills.

**We Are Looking For Someone Who Has

**

• A relevant educational background in Engineering, Automation, IT, Project Management or a related technical discipline.

• At least three years of project management experience, preferably within industrial IT, automation, manufacturing or a related technical environment.

• A practical understanding of industrial IT/OT systems and automation technologies, with the ability to engage effectively with technical specialists.

• Experience in project planning, scheduling, cost estimation, forecasting, risk management or coordinating project deliverables.

• Experience working with multidisciplinary teams and influencing stakeholders without direct line management responsibility.

• Strong communication, collaboration and organisational skills.

• Professional proficiency in English.

• Experience within pharmaceutical manufacturing or another regulated industry would be advantageous. However, we also welcome relevant experience from engineering consultancies, technology suppliers, system integrators and other highly automated manufacturing industries.

• Familiarity with technologies such as DCS, MES, process historians, DeltaV or ABB 800xA would be beneficial, although you are not expected to be a technical specialist across every platform.

• Danish language skills would be an advantage but are not essential.

• As a person, you are structured, curious and proactive. You enjoy working with others, taking ownership of your responsibilities and finding solutions to complex challenges.

• You are comfortable asking questions, challenging existing approaches constructively and learning from experienced colleagues.

Above all, you bring a collaborative mindset, a willingness to develop and the ambition to make a meaningful contribution to both project outcomes and the continued development of the team.

**About The Department

**You will join the Pre-G3 Projects & Project Execution department within API Expansions, supporting the IT, Automation and Robotics elements of major capital investment projects.

Our department brings together Project Managers, Project Directors and Solution Architects who collaborate across disciplines to support the development of new facilities and the modernisation of existing manufacturing operations.

A central part of our approach is to identify and resolve technical uncertainties early in the project lifecycle, enabling stronger project definition, more reliable forecasts and smoother execution.

We work closely with colleagues across Novo, as well as external engineering partners and technology suppliers, supporting projects in Denmark and internationally.

You will join a collaborative environment where knowledge sharing, continuous improvement and professional development are encouraged.

You will receive support from your manager and experienced colleagues as you develop your knowledge of our project standards, technologies and ways of working, with the opportunity to take increasing ownership of complex projects.

The position is based in Kalundborg, with an expectation of approximately four days per week on site. The remaining day may be worked flexibly, including from another Novo location, subject to business needs.

**Why Novo

**At Novo, we are driving change to defeat serious chronic diseases.

For more than a century, we have worked to improve the lives of people living with serious chronic conditions. Our success is built on scientific innovation, a commitment to quality and the dedication of our colleagues around the world.

Joining Novo means becoming part of an organisation where your work contributes to something bigger.

Within API Expansions, you will have the opportunity to help develop and modernise manufacturing facilities that support the delivery of life changing medicines to patients around the world.

**Working at Novo

**Every day, we seek solutions that make a lasting difference for patients.

We recognise that meaningful progress requires collaboration, curiosity and the willingness to challenge conventional thinking.

Our people bring different perspectives, experiences and expertise, united by a shared commitment to improving patients' lives.

We provide an environment where you can take ownership, develop professionally and contribute to projects that have a meaningful impact.

**Salary And Benefits

**The salary range for this position is 651,000 to 956,900 DKK per annum, depending on experience, qualifications and applicable local arrangements.

Novo offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support the wellbeing, development and long term success of our employees.

**Incentives And Benefits

**In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for benefits and incentive arrangements in accordance with applicable Novo policies and local employment terms.

Further information about the relevant compensation and benefits package will be provided during the recruitment process.

**What We Offer

As Construction Manager, you will act as Sund & Bælt’s day-to-day coordinating client representative on site. You will monitor the contractor’s work and contribute to ensuring safe and controlled execution in accordance with the contract, approved methods and project requirements.

You will be part of the Great Belt Projects team and collaborate closely with project management, Contract Administration, Project Controls, Design & Engineering, HSE specialists, consultants, the contractor and Great Belt Operations.

Programme & Project Manager, PMO

Are you motivated by leading projects from idea to implementation? Do you thrive on bringing structure to complexity and making real change across markets and functions? Then this could be your opportunity to make a visible difference in a Nordic organisation with strong ambitions.

We are looking for an experienced Programme & Project Manager with solid project delivery skills.

**Your Role

**As our Programme & Project Manager, you will report to the General Manager, Strategy & Business Development and be responsible for leading complex cross-Nordic projects end-to-end, from scoping and planning through execution, handover and value realisation. You will work closely with stakeholders across Coop’s organisations in Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Finland.

In addition, you will support programme coordination when related projects are grouped into a programme. Here, you will establish governance and manage cross-project dependencies, progress, risks and benefits.

You will work closely with our 3 Project Managers.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Manage complex cross-Nordic projects end-to-end, from scoping and planning through execution, handover and value realisation tracking

• Establish clear project objectives, plans, milestones, timelines, dependencies, risks and decision points

• Handle project governance, prioritisation and gate approvals based on business value, impact and capacity, in cooperation with the management team

• Support programme management by coordinating related initiatives and managing cross-project dependencies

• Ensure accurate project data and reporting in the project management system

• Improve project processes, tools, templates and onboarding materials

• Proactively manage project risks and issues to ensure smooth project delivery

**To do well in the role, we imagine that you:

**

• Bring effective communication and stakeholder management skills, plus the ability to deliver clear presentations

• Have experience leading complex cross-functional projects. Experience with programme coordination is an advantage.

• Have a solid understanding of project governance, planning, risk management and stakeholder management

• Have experience working with business cases, financials, and value tracking

• Have experience with process improvement. Lean certification is a plus.

• Have advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office and project management tools

• Are fluent in English, both written and spoken; knowledge of Swedish, Norwegian, and Danish is an asset

• Are a certified Project Manager (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent)

**Personal Competencies

**You are a proactive and results-driven project professional who enjoys working across functions, cultures and organisational levels.

**In Addition, You

**

• Have strong analytical capabilities and a structured approach

• Are skilled in stakeholder management and aligning others without formal authority

• Are highly organised and results-oriented

• Have strong prioritization skills and the ability to manage competing demands

• Take initiative and question existing ways of working to make improvements

• Thrive in dynamic environments where change and continuous improvement are part of everyday business

**What We Offer

**

• An important role with the opportunity to lead business-critical projects and programmes across the Nordics

• A central position in a growing PMO where you can help shape standards, ways of working, and execution discipline

• Close collaboration with internal and external senior stakeholders and broad exposure across markets, functions, and strategic priorities

• Opportunities for both professional growth and personal development in an ambitious and collaborative environment

• The chance to be part of a purpose-driven company that is shaping the future of Nordic private brands for millions of consumers

If you are ready to take the next step in your career and join Coop Trading's PMO team, please send us your CV no later than 20th of November 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis.

Place of work: Vesterbro, Copenhagen

We believe that a strong culture is built through spending time together. Our Vesterbro office is therefore our primary place of work, while we offer the flexibility to work from home when needed.

You can expect approximately five days of travel per year, with the possibility of overnight stays.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact General Manager, S&BD, Gustav Gaarde at +45 2777 2575.

**About Us

**Coop Trading’s purpose is to make everyday life better through leading Nordic private brands for 27 million Nordic consumers by delivering high-quality products at fair prices. Our portfolio encompasses both food and daily non-food items within our private brands: Xtra, Coop, and Änglamark.

Coop Trading represents Coop in Sweden, Denmark, Norway, as well as SOK in Finland. Through our private brands, we are proud to be present on every third dinner table in Nordic homes. On behalf of our four partners, we develop products for our private brand portfolio through innovation, product development, and negotiating Nordic agreements.

Coop Trading is a dynamic, responsible, and ambitious workplace. We are 140 dedicated professionals in Denmark and in Spain, as well as a network of trusted partners across the Nordic region. We challenge the status quo to deliver the best and most innovative private-brand products.

A cornerstone of our identity is our continuous commitment to fostering an engaging and appreciative work environment and to being an exceptional place to work.

Phanofi is a DTU spin-out building the next generation of optical communication infrastructure. We design integrated photonic interconnect chips that dramatically reduce power consumption and increase data throughput for AI datacenters, quantum computing, and space applications. As a diverse team of 15 people, we are at an exciting inflection point, and we are looking for a senior leader to drive our commercial growth.

As Head of Business Development, you will own Phanofi's commercial trajectory. Reporting directly to the CEO, you will define and execute the go-to-market strategy, forge high-value industry partnerships, lead the company's funding and grant initiatives, and represent Phanofi on the global stage. This is a senior, highly visible role with the opportunity, and expectation, to build the business development function from the ground up.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Strategy & Commercial Leadership: Define and execute Phanofi’s business development strategy, establish commercial goals and KPIs, and drive market expansion across AI datacenters, quantum computing, and space sectors.

• Industry Relationships & Partnerships: Build and maintain strategic relationships with key stakeholders across the data communications, semiconductor, and photonics industries, while leading partnership discussions and negotiations.

• Market Intelligence & Business Insights: Conduct market research, monitor industry trends and competitive developments, and translate technical innovations into compelling business opportunities and commercial strategies.

• Brand Representation & External Communications: Represent Phanofi at industry conferences, trade shows, and networking events, while supporting thought leadership, public relations, and external communications activities.

**What We Are Looking For

**

• Experience: You bring a minimum of 5 years of experience in business development, or commercial leadership within the photonics, semiconductor, deep-tech, or related technology industries. You have a proven track record of securing strategic partnerships, commercial agreements, or major funding opportunities.

• Technical Background: You have a strong engineering or scientific background, preferably in photonics, integrated optics, electronics, communications, or a related field, enabling you to engage confidently with technical teams and customers.

• Education: A master’s degree in Engineering, Physics, or a related discipline is preferred. An MBA combined with a technical degree is considered an advantage.

• Skills: You possess strong business development, partnership management, negotiation, and market analysis skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into compelling business value propositions.

• Leadership & Soft Skills: You are a strategic and entrepreneurial leader who can influence cross-functional teams, communicate effectively with both technical and commercial stakeholders, and thrive in a fast-paced deep-tech startup environment. Fluency in English is required; Danish or other European languages are considered a plus.

**The Perks

**We care about your long-term growth and well-being. We offer performance-based stock options, healthcare insurance, professional development support, and a positive culture with free snacks. You will also enjoy standard Danish benefits, including 5 weeks of paid holiday and maternity/paternity leave.

**How To Apply

**If you are interested in joining us on our entrepreneurial journey, we encourage you to submit your CV and a cover letter. We look forward to hearing from you!

Summary

Please note this internship will be a minimum of three months, you must be enrolled as a student on a PhD course and available to start no later than 1st June 2027

Within Apple’s Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning organization (AIML), you can take part in the ongoing revolution that machine learning plays in daily life. Apple’s fully-integrated hardware and software provide unique opportunities to deliver amazing experiences, all while prioritizing user privacy. As an AIML intern, you will get to explore new methods, apply machine learning to solve ambitious problems, advance state-of-the art technology through research and publications, challenge existing metrics or protocols, and develop new theories that will impact the way we understand machine learning and the experiences it can enable. Come collaborate with some of the best in the business and help build the world's most innovative products and experiences.

Description

In an AIML internship, you will collaborate with researchers, engineers, and program/project managers to tackle innovative challenges. You will also receive technical mentorship and guidance that allows you to learn new things every day, gain practical skills, build real world experience, develop a greater understanding of our industry, and form valuable connections. Together, you and your team will partner to design and implement an innovative solution for a Machine Learning problem that is meaningful. At the end of your internship, you will have the opportunity to meet and present your work to AIML leadership. Where appropriate, you will have the opportunity to submit your work for publication at a suitable conference.

We are offering a research internship opportunity to work directly with our research team in Copenhagen, Denmark on projects ranging from multilingual automatic speech recognition (ASR) to multilingual speech language models (SpeechLMs). The internship topic can be fitted to the candidate's interests, with example topics including language interference and cross-lingual transfer, the effect of training data composition on multilingual generalization, low-resource languages and dialects, efficient adaptation and continual learning, self-supervised and multimodal learning, and interpretability of multilingual speech models.

Minimum Qualifications

• Working towards a doctoral degree in computer science, engineering, data science, applied mathematics, cognitive science, computational linguistics or equivalent.

• In-depth knowledge of deep learning and statistical machine learning, with strong Python programming skills and experience with ML libraries such as PyTorch or TensorFlow

• Research experience in multilingual or cross-lingual speech and language processing, such as ASR, speech LMs, or audio language models

• Interest in Speech and Language Processing

• Strong demonstrable record of publishing academic research in ML-related peer-reviewed venues (NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML...), including language- and speech-specific ones (e.g. *ACL, Interspeech, ICASSP)

• Ability to collaborate with others and to deliver ML technologies aligned with Apple's core values: the highest standards of quality, scientific rigour, innovation, and respect for user privacy

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience training or fine-tuning large speech or language models

• Experience with language interference, cross-lingual transfer, or low-resource languages and dialects

• Interest in the interpretability and efficient adaptation of speech models

Phanofi is a DTU spin-out building the next generation of optical communication infrastructure. We design integrated photonic interconnect chips that dramatically reduce power consumption and increase data throughput for AI datacenters, quantum computing, and space applications. As a diverse team of 15 people, we are at an exciting inflection point, and we are looking for a talented student assistant to strengthen our embedded systems work.

As Student Assistant in Embedded Systems, you will develop the firmware that brings our photonics lab setups to life. Working closely with our engineering team, you will build STM32-based systems for signal generation, acquisition, processing, and monitoring, turning hardware into working, measurable systems. This is a hands-on role with the opportunity, and expectation, to see your code run on real lab equipment from day one.

Key Responsibilities

Firmware Development: Design, implement, and maintain C firmware for STM32 microcontrollers, ensuring robust, well-structured code that supports our lab setups and experiments.

Interfaces & Device Control: Connect, configure, and control external devices over SPI and I2C, while ensuring reliable communication between the microcontroller and the surrounding hardware.

Signal Generation, Acquisition & Processing: Generate signals and waveforms, acquire and monitor analog signals, and process the acquired data on the MCU through filtering, averaging, and feature extraction.

Lab Work & Documentation: Bring up and debug hardware using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and debuggers, while documenting code and results clearly and maintaining version control with Git.

What We Are Looking For

Education: You are currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechatronics, Physics, or a related discipline.

Embedded Experience: You bring good knowledge of C and microcontroller fundamentals along with practical experience with STM32 or comparable ARM Cortex-M microcontrollers.

Interfaces & Peripherals: You have hands-on experience with SPI, I2C, DMA, timers, ADC, and DAC, from configuring the peripheral to debugging it on the bench.

Electronics: You are able to read and understand electronic circuits, schematics, and datasheets. Electronics skills such as circuit design, soldering, and measurement, as well as real-world lab experience, are considered an advantage. Experience with PCB design (KiCad or Altium) and Python or MATLAB for data analysis is a plus.

Soft Skills: You are a structured and independent problem-solver who enjoys working at the boundary between hardware and software, communicates effectively with colleagues, and thrives in a fast-paced deep-tech startup environment. Fluency in English is required.

The Perks

We care about your growth and development. You will work on cutting-edge photonics and embedded technology alongside highly motivated colleagues, with access to a well-equipped lab. We offer competitive hourly pay, flexible hours that fit around your lectures and exams, a positive culture with free snacks, and the opportunity to write your Bachelor’s or Master’s thesis with us.

How To Apply

If you are interested in joining us on our entrepreneurial journey, we encourage you to submit your CV, a current transcript of records, and a few lines about an embedded project you have worked on (a link to a Git repository is a plus). We aim to fill the position as soon as possible. We look forward to hearing from you!

Corti builds AI for critical industries. We started in healthcare, where messy inputs, specialized knowledge, and consequential errors make demanding engineering problems unavoidable. Today we train and post-train models, build agents, and turn research into APIs that developers use to build their products. Our platform supports more than one million production interactions every week.

We are building Europe’s alternative to closed AI: ambitious model development, published research, and AI infrastructure that gives developers control over the systems they depend on.

Our platform and APIs provide the building blocks for specialized intelligence that organizations own:

• 
Models: frontier and open-weight models with reasoning, tool calling, structured output, and embeddings through an OpenAI-compatible interface, plus custom models trained and post-trained on an organization’s own data.

• 
Sovereign compute: GPU capacity on Corti-operated European infrastructure for teams that need their data and workloads to stay in Europe.

• 
Agents: a harness to build, evaluate, and optimize agents that connect to real systems, with planning, tool use, external knowledge, persistent context, human approval, and observable execution.

• 
Speech: live dictation, conversational transcription, and batch audio processing.

• 
Clinical documentation: fact extraction as conversations unfold, and document generation with explicit schemas and controllable synthesis.

• 
Medical coding: code predictions from clinical narratives, linked to supporting passages.

Explore the platform at docs.corti.ai.

You want to train models at the frontier, and you want the science in the open, where other engineers can inspect it. At Corti, you don't have to choose.

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer in our Applied AI team, you drive large-scale training and post-training alongside researchers and engineers. Your decisions span the training recipe, the evaluation, and the system that serves the result. The calls are consequential, and you stay close enough to the implementation to understand why they succeed or fail.

• 
Designing and running distributed training, including architecture, data pipelines, parallelism, checkpointing, evaluation, and recovery.

• 
Improving model capabilities through supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and distillation.

• 
Finding the causes of unstable training, inefficient communication, poor utilization, and unexpected regressions.

• 
Developing models for agentic work: choosing tools, using evidence, maintaining context, and completing complex tasks reliably.

• 
Building evaluations that expose failure modes and establish whether an improvement holds outside the training distribution, including LLM-as-judge systems you build and calibrate

• 
Creating and curating training data, including synthetic data pipelines that feed real training runs.

• 
Turning stronger models into practical APIs by improving latency, throughput, memory use, and serving cost.

Which capabilities belong in the weights, and which need tools or retrieval? You help decide, and you build the experiments that establish the answer.

Put the science where engineers can inspect it

We believe engineers should be able to examine the methods and evidence behind the systems they build on. We publish research, release benchmark resources, and document how our platform works. Read the work behind our clinical APIs: corti.ai/research

You have depth and an urge to experiment

• 
You have trained large language models and owned technically complex ML work. You can explain a difficult run in detail: the architecture, the bottleneck, the failed hypothesis, and the evidence that changed your mind.

• 
You bring strong practical distributed-training experience, and depth in areas such as mixture-of-experts models, reinforcement learning, or distillation. Experience serving open-weight models is a plus. You write code other engineers can build on and make technical trade offs clear.

• 
You know post-training methods from the inside.Preference optimisation and reinforcement learning have quirks, reward hacking, runs that look stable until they collapse, and signals that turns out to be noise. You have hit these problems and learned to spot them before they cost you a week.

• 
You have hands-on experience with the data the models learn from. You have built training-data pipelines, ideally synthetic ones, and stayed close to the training that consumed your data.

• 
You have evaluated LLMs in production. You have built and calibrated LLM-as-judge systems to automate that evaluation, and you know when a judge's score means something and when it just flatters the model it is scoring.

• 
You also have the itch to investigate. A new model, paper, or agent framework appears, and you want to understand what actually changed. You build experiments, compare approaches, and test the claims. Perhaps your latest side project involves agents building tools, coordinating with other agents, or failing in a surprisingly instructive way. We want to hear about it.

• 
A relevant advanced degree is welcome; equivalent experience matters just as much.

This is a full-time role reporting to the CTO. We provide equipment and relocation support.

We welcome different backgrounds and paths into machine learning. If the work fits your ambition and you bring substantial relevant experience, apply even if you do not match every item.

Send us something you built, a hard problem you solved, or a result you think deserves to be challenged. A link is enough. Help us shape the models, agents, and infrastructure developers build on next.

Additionally, we want to remind you that experience comes in many forms, and we're passionate about creating teams with a multitude of perspectives! If you believe your experience is close to what we're looking for but not an exact match, we still hope you consider applying!

Do you want to help shape the strategic direction of Dalux’s international bid activities? And are you motivated by bringing together legal, commercial, and technical perspectives to develop strong bid strategies? Then you might be our new Bid Manager!

**First, who on earth is Dalux?

**Dalux is a Danish-owned international software company that digitises the construction and facilities management industries. Our solutions within BIM and digital project management are used by contractors, building owners, and consultants in more than 170 countries. With more than 50 offices and colleagues across 28 countries, we are in the midst of an exciting growth journey.

**A key role with strategic responsibility

**As Bid Manager at Dalux, you will play a central role in our commercial strategy and be responsible for driving and further developing a professional, international bid function based in Copenhagen.

You will be at the centre of our bid activities across markets and countries, bringing together legal, commercial, and technical perspectives into one cohesive strategy. Working closely with Sales, Legal, senior management, and technical specialists, you will ensure that our bids are competitive, legally sound, and strategically prioritised.

The majority of our tenders come from international markets, meaning you will play an important role in understanding and navigating different countries’ regulations, cultures, and approaches to tender processes.

**Your key responsibilities will include:

**

• Driving and further developing a centralised bid function responsible for tender and bid processes across markets.

• Developing and shaping bid strategies in close collaboration with senior management and relevant commercial teams.

• Conducting strategic bid/no-bid assessments to ensure that Dalux prioritises the opportunities with the strongest strategic fit and greatest potential for success.

• Analysing tender documentation, identifying risks and opportunities, and challenging the basis for our participation.

• Ensuring legal quality and effective risk management in collaboration with our Legal team.

• Coordinating cross-functional teams throughout complex bid processes and ensuring progress, structure, and quality.

• Gathering and applying market and competitor insights to strengthen Dalux’s position.

• Continuously optimising processes and ways of working to make the bid function more efficient and create space for strategic work.

**This sounds like a great fit for me!

**We imagine that you have solid experience with tender and bid processes, for example as a Bid Manager, Senior Bid Specialist or so. You have a strong understanding of public and private bids and tender regulations, including relevant EU rules, and can translate legal requirements into commercial decisions.

You are interested in working internationally and motivated by learning about new markets, cultures, and local interpretations of regulations and tender processes. International experience is an advantage, but your curiosity and desire to work across borders are just as important. You communicate confidently in English.

The role is first and foremost about setting the direction, driving the process, and ensuring quality across our bids. You will not necessarily be responsible for producing large volumes of bid material yourself. Instead, you will be able to quality-assure, challenge, and bring together input from relevant commercial and technical colleagues to create a strong and cohesive proposal.

As a person, you are analytical, structured, and strategic in your approach. You have a natural project management overview and the ability to create structure and drive progress in complex processes involving many stakeholders.

You are confident in your professional expertise and have the maturity and composure needed to engage with different types of people from specialists and colleagues across our international organisation to managers and senior leadership. You are able to challenge and provide direction while remaining humble in your approach and bringing different perspectives together around a shared decision.

**Be part of Dalux’s success!

**At Dalux, we are committed to creating a workplace that inspires and motivates. We believe that wellbeing and job satisfaction go hand in hand with a healthy work environment which is why we believe excessive overtime should be a thing of the past.

We have an informal yet professional culture where everyone is welcome, without strict dress codes or unnecessary titles. You will become part of an engaged community where we do not just come together for work, but also for social activities such as shared dinners, workshops, wine tastings, knitting clubs, and running clubs or whatever we come up with next.

At our headquarters in Copenhagen, you will join a dedicated team in Business Operations, and you will collaborate and spar with colleagues across our offices in Denmark, Norway, Sweden, and the rest of Europe. Wherever you are, you can expect a strong sense of community and a shared focus on innovation and success for both our customers and Dalux.

**Application deadline:

**As soon as possible
